source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Gather all the essential information about the incident immediately following the occurrence. This includes the date and time of the accident, the location where it occurred, the names and job titles of the people involved, any witnesses, and the type of injury or damage sustained.

3. Conduct interviews with the people involved and any witnesses. Note down their accounts of the event in detail, including specific actions, what they observed, and any contributing factors to the accident.

4. Take thorough incident scene documentation with photos and video if possible. These records should capture the environment before any changes are made to the area, including damaged equipment or hazardous conditions that may have contributed to the accident.

5. Complete an official incident report form. Most organizations have standardized forms for this purpose. Ensure that all sections are filled out accurately, including personal details of those involved, specifics of the event, and details of the injury or damage.
